name: mirage
text:
v1.0.61 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.61
It has the Run on GitHub master switch (on by default: the phone only sends settings and shows what the engine does; off = phone mode, engine shut down and engine trading OFF). I checked every loop the phone runs while GitHub drives; the scan, auto-bet, bids, sockets and CNO already stand down, so nothing wasted was left to remove. Still open for later versions: Kalshi on the engine posting more (CH72), live rows and CNO auto-bet from the engine.
